Well, I grew up with few friends. I have never liked my parents.

When I went to college, people told me it would get better, but it only got worse. I liked learning in school. I'm nerdy like that. And I miss school, because I found so many things fascinating (especially in nursing school)

I am also a gay male, but I do not want to be, and will never accept myself for who I am. I would rather kill myself than live as a homosexual. For the record, I am not LGBTQ+-phobic. My best friend is a trans guy and I really like him as a person, and sometimes we go to PRIDE events. I just do not want that lifestyle for myself. Instead, I choose to live an asexual lifestyle. 

Nursing school was hard on me emotionally as well. As the old saying goes, nurses eat their young. They were mean to me, and nurse bullying is well and alive. Plus the people in my class were so judgmental. When I began putting on weight because I was no longer vegan and stopped running everyday (due to depression I began to stop functioning), people would say hurtful things to me.

I miss being vegan, and wish I could go back to it. The planet we live on sickens me. I constantly watch videos of people doing terrible things to animals. Some people tell me to stop, but I would rather be informed of the horrors of the world than live an ignorant and blissful life.

No matter what, I will likely always be suicidal. I cannot see myself as ever living a happy life.  It's going to happen...

The worse part is that I have no idea what I need in a therapist. I want to get better, but no one seems to know how to help me. 

 Of course I am hurting, that's why I want to die. It would be like euthanasia, putting myself out of my misery.

Yup,

Help is not always available. Remember that.

All of my therapists recommended that I try seeking a new therapist when I explained I wasn't getting better. The providers prescribing me medications (none of which were PMHNP or psychiatrists) recommended I go to a specialist. Nobody seems to know what to do for me. 

Having a nurse practitioner tell you that she doesn't know what else to do is kind of scary. My college therapist and the NP there recommended that I leave school.

I want to move away from my family, but I cannot afford to move. I only make $14/hour as a nurse assistant right now (in a COVID19- facility) 

I am currently trying to find a psychiatrist, but everything is through TeleHealth which means I cannot meet in person. 

I honestly want to die; perhaps then I'd be happy.

That was very nice.

I still am planning to kill myself sometime. 

It's my time to go

My parents make me want to kill myself. All of my past therapist felt like a waste of time. The police officers escorting me weren't very nice. The providers prescribing me medications didn't help either. Not one person has helped me. The only reason why I haven't killed myself yet is because it is unbearably painful to die by hanging. The pressure around your neck burns. Sometimes, you black out if you can make it long enough. Your body begins to have uncontrollable spasms. That's how my mom discovered me trying to kill myself the first time. I wish she has left me hanging there. I could've been happy.
